description: Linear regulator (LDO), fixed 3.3 V, 1 A, input up to 15 V, about 1.1 V dropout

datasheet.revision: AMS1117 datasheet (8 pages, SOT-223 drawing AMS DRW# 042292)

recommended.what: VIN (VIN - VOUT from 1.5 V to 12 V for the regulation specified)

parameters.conditions: AMS1117-3.3; IOUT=0 mA bias, (VIN-VOUT)=1.5 V, TJ=25 degC; datasheet row lists the fixed-voltage versions together

source.revision: AMS1117 datasheet (8 pages, as downloaded 2026-10-20; no revision date printed)
source.location: p. 3, Electrical Characteristics, Quiescent Current row

parameters.conditions: Operating junction temperature range, control section and power transistor; printed in the Absolute Maximum Ratings box

source.revision: AMS1117 datasheet (8 pages, as downloaded 2026-10-20; no revision date printed)

notes: The output capacitor is part of the regulator's compensation: 22 uF on VOUT keeps it stable in all conditions (the datasheet's figure uses solid tantalum).
It needs about 10 mA of load to regulate within specification.
Dropout up to 1.3 V at 0.8 A: from 5 V in, 3.3 V out is near the limit at full load.
Dissipation (VIN - VOUT) x IOUT goes out through the tab: give the VOUT tab copper (the datasheet's table: about 55 °C/W with 1000 mm² on top).
The input capacitor is not in the datasheet's schematic; 10 uF close to VIN is the usual practice.

pins.source: AMS1117 datasheet, Pin connections (p. 1): SOT-223 1 GND/ADJ, 2 VOUT, 3 VIN, tab VOUT
